research.title: Occlusion Sensitivity in Object Detection
bullets: Designed controlled experiments varying occlusion placement and severity to assess detection performance across object sizes and scene complexity.
Analyzed localization errors and missed detections, separating sensitivity to foreground obstruction from effects of background clutter.

research.title: Illumination Shift in Road Scene Segmentation
bullets: Designed comparisons of photometric augmentation and input normalization for semantic segmentation across daylight, twilight, and nighttime road imagery.
Analyzed classwise segmentation errors and prediction confidence to characterize failures involving shadows, reflective surfaces, and poorly illuminated boundaries.

publications.title: Photometric Augmentation and Normalization Under Illumination Shift in Road Scene Segmentation

work.title: Image Processing Service Maintenance
bullets: Implemented image validation and preprocessing components for an internal processing service, handling unsupported formats, malformed inputs, and inconsistent metadata.
Maintained regression tests and investigated processing failures using service logs, coordinating fixes with downstream application owners.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Retrieval Representations
bullets: Implemented image retrieval pipelines using color histograms and pretrained convolutional features, with consistent preprocessing and nearest neighbor ranking.
Compared retrieval precision under cropping, illumination changes, and background variation, inspecting failure cases involving visually similar but semantically distinct images.

projects.title: Classical Optical Flow Under Motion and Lighting Changes
bullets: Implemented Lucas–Kanade and Horn–Schunck optical flow methods, using image pyramids to examine sensitivity to displacement and texture.
Compared endpoint errors on image sequences with reference flow, analyzing failures near motion boundaries and under brightness changes.
